_comment: Per-run freeze record for the G3-BAND5-0903 Gate F addendum: a played S09 (Sigil gate -> outer watch -> checkpoint -> final camp decision -> Hall threshold) against a synthetically-seeded entry save, per operator_harness.gd's own documented mechanism (`_freeze_display_claim()`'s header: 'a run that wants a logic lane must SAY SO IN THE FREEZE RECORD BEFORE THE RUN'). This run's logic lane is genuinely headless in this container -- no xvfb, no X11, `tools/gate_f/run_segment.sh S09` (no --capture). S09.json declares `evidence_lane: logic` and `capture_lane: S09C`; every prescribed capture step is delegated, not taken in this process. This record exists only to stop CD-8b's pre-flight contradiction check from binding this run to the unrelated 2026-08-27 candidate freeze at ralph/reports/gate-f-candidate/RUN_METADATA.json, which correctly describes THAT run's own xvfb/X11 capture-lane environment, not this one.
_comment_no_capture_lane_run: This addendum runs the logic lane only, against a synthetic entry seed, to get a real measured dead-travel number. No capture-lane (S09C) run was performed in this container -- xvfb/opengl3 capture mode was not exercised for this addendum.
